name: Variable-scoped NotResource on Deny (false-deny guard)
note: Deny s3:* on every resource EXCEPT the caller's own home prefix (${aws:username}). A literal glob fails to match the '${...}' text against a concrete ARN, so the resource looks NOT excluded and the request is reported EXPLICIT_DENY - a false deny (real AWS spares alice's own arn:aws:s3:::alice/* after substitution). Correct behavior: whether the Deny fires depends on the runtime value, so the outcome is CONDITIONAL, never a definitive deny.
